topic: What the ancient art of Pala can teach modern OTT showrunners
caption:
My grandfather used to sit through all-night Pala performances, completely hooked by a single performer holding cymbals. 

If you want to know how to structure an eight-episode OTT series, skip the Hollywood pitch decks and watch a Pala Gayaka. 

They transition from high-brow mythology to sharp street-level wit in seconds, keeping a sleepy midnight crowd from walking away. 

We think we invented the cliffhanger, but our folk artists have been mastering audience retention under petromax lamps for centuries.
